_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: Good morning Pookie. Since youre waking up alot earlier than me I just want to say I hope you have an amazing day today. I hope all of the pictures you take turn out amazing and that you have so much fun. I love you so so so much. I'll have another message for you later today:)
